title: Strict Hamiltonian conservation for axially symmetric Kerr perturbations
source_version: Official SIGMA 21 (2025) journal PDF and native TeX; acquired 2026-09-30; exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The regularized positive energy must be compatible with the constrained Einstein–wave-map evolution and with the harmonic-to-Weyl–Papapetrou gauge. Strict conservation requires separate horizon, axis, and infinity flux estimates including gauge and conformal terms; a formal local divergence identity does not establish the result.
author: Nishanth Gudapati
